# Installing a cluster on {{ ibm_power_server_title }} with customizations {#installing-ibm-power-vs-customizations}

To install a customized OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_power_server_name }}, use installer-provisioned infrastructure and adjust the `install-config.yaml` parameters before you run the installation program.
